name: Sólido LLC
description: Sólido is a furniture manufacturer in Phoenix, AZ, specializing in custom seating and case goods. Previously, we operated as a subcontractor for various vendors, producing custom-made hospitality furniture for 4- and 5-star hotels across the United States. Our projects range from crafting a few finely detailed custom pieces to making hundreds of items for large-scale projects. In early 2019, we decided to launch and rebrand as Sólido, functioning independently. We focus on creating high-quality custom furniture using various materials, including wood, metal, upholstery, and stone.
